name: Lower third
what: Who is talking: a name and a role low in the frame - a colour bar wiping in with the name riding on it, a thin line drawing with the name rising over it, two stacked boxes, or a round badge with your @handle. It stays, then leaves the other way.
origin: lower thirds - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: box wipes 10 f (slow end), words rise behind a mask 4 f later (10 f), the second line 6 f after; leaves: words 8 f (slow start), boxes 8 f
